verdict.rationale: Canny shows status-change and close-the-loop pieces. Status sync from Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp and Asana can change a feature's status automatically, the MCP server lets teams update statuses and reply to customers, and the changelog is pitched as a way to 'show customers you heard them.' No evidence says customers who requested or voted on a feature are notified automatically when its status changes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic status-change notifications to requesters/voters, notification channels (email or in-app), configuration controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
